upstream_schema_attribution.description: 4-tier claim-boundary catalog separating reported findings, mathematical reconstruction, transfer boundary, and explicit non-claims, paired with deterministic seed-locked Lane A vs. Lane B comparison.

entries.title: Autonomous Cell-View Sorting Efficiency & Frozen-Cell Error Tolerance

reported: Decentralized cell-view Bubble and Insertion sort perform the same mean number of swaps (~2,449-2,483 on n=100) as top-down traditional algorithms, while requiring 1.50x and 2.03x fewer total comparisons+swaps.
Decentralized Selection sort requires ~11x more swaps than top-down Selection sort because autonomous cells swap eagerly toward their target pointer before scanning the full array.

With immovable (stuck) frozen defects (f=1..3), cell-view Selection sort achieves significantly lower final monotonicity error (~1, ~2, ~3) than Bubble or Insertion sort (~2, ~4, ~5.5) because Selection cells can swap across long-range index gaps past an immovable barrier.
reconstruction: Implemented in sorting_morphogenesis.py via Cell dataclasses with local perception-action rules (_propose) and three execution schedulers: random-asynchronous active-cell sampling (simulate), synchronous maximal matching (simulate_parallel), and literal per-cell OS threads with shared mutex (simulate_threaded).

Insertion-cell prefix scanning (_left_sorted) resets its running comparison value at frozen cells (matching InsertionSortCell.is_enable_to_move L68-82), preventing a single frozen defect from halting all downstream Insertion cells.
Paired A/B lane comparison (compare_lanes_ab) locks the initial value permutation V_0, defect indices F_0, and per-replicate RNG seed_r across Lane A and Lane B.
transfer_boundary: Cells inhabit a 1D discrete index array (0..n-1) with instantaneous swap operations rather than continuous 2D/3D viscoelastic tissue mechanics.

Selection cells possess a non-local index pointer (target) capable of inspecting and swapping with arbitrary array slots, whereas Bubble and Insertion cells only swap with immediate neighbors (p-1, p+1).
does_not_claim: Does not claim that biological cells execute digital integer comparisons or hold integer array indices in memory.

Does not claim that Selection sort's long-range swap primitive represents direct physical teleportation of cells in vivo; it abstracts long-range signaling or directed migration past a local obstacle.

entries.title: Delayed Gratification: Temporary Increases in Monotonicity Error to Bypass Defects

reported: When immovable frozen cells are introduced (f=0..3), autonomous Bubble and Insertion ensembles exhibit Temporary Monotonicity Error Increases followed by larger error reductions (Delayed Gratification > 0).
Cell-view Bubble Delayed Gratification increases monotonically with frozen-cell count f (from ~0.24-0.38 at f=0 to ~0.37-0.51 at f=3), exceeding top-down Bubble sort (<0.25).
reconstruction: Implemented in delayed_gratification() and _discrepancy_runs() following Zhangtaining/cell_research/analysis/delay_gratification_analysis_for_not_move.py: consecutive non-zero changes in monotonicity error are segmented into alternating setback (y > 0) and recovery (x > 0) runs, averaging (x - y) / y across all setback-recovery pairs.
transfer_boundary: Delayed Gratification is measured purely on the 1D global monotonicity error trajectory after each swap step; individual cells do not compute or optimize the global monotonicity objective.
Apparent 'goal-directed' barrier traversal emerges from stochastic local neighbor swaps and Insertion prefix resets around frozen defects, not from explicit multi-step lookahead planning.
does_not_claim: Does not claim that individual sorting cells possess cognitive foresight, internal world models, or explicit reward-discounting parameters.

entries.title: Spontaneous Algotype Aggregation & Cross-Purpose Chimeric Competition

reported: In chimeric arrays mixing two algotypes (50/50 B+S, I+S, or B+I) with unique values 1..n, spatial algotype aggregation rises from the 0.50 random baseline to a transient peak of 0.64-0.65 mid-sort (~20-55% progress) before relaxing back to 0.50 once values are fully determined.

When duplicate values (10 copies each of 1..10) or opposite sorting directions (increasing vs. decreasing) are used, algotype aggregation remains permanently elevated (0.66-0.95) at completion because equal-valued or conflicting cells segregate by algotype kinetics.
In cross-purpose opposite-direction chimeras (Fig. 9), Bubble dominates Selection and Insertion (final sortedness hierarchy B > S > I: B+I ~74%, B+S ~43%, I+S ~38%).
reconstruction: Implemented in aggregation_value() as the fraction of adjacent pairs sharing the same algotype, and evaluated across normalized sorting-progress grids (0..100%) in exp_chimeric_aggregation(), exp_cross_purpose_chimeras(), and paired A/B comparisons.
transfer_boundary: Cells cannot sense or read a neighbor's algotype label (B, I, or S); they only observe numeric cell.value. Algotype clustering is an emergent kinematic sorting-speed asymmetry (analogous to differential motility) rather than homophilic differential adhesion (Steinberg's Differential Adhesion Hypothesis).
does_not_claim: Does not claim that algotype aggregation is driven by cadherin-like surface-binding affinity or explicit self-recognition receptors.
